title: Uruguayan Bean Empanadas
description: Garlicky Uruguayan empanadas filled with chilli bean paste, made with long fermentation dough, perfect for kids and adults alike, without onion or garlic for a friendly twist
instructions: In a large mixing bowl combine flour, salt, sugar, and yeast to make the dough.
Add olive oil and warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough ferment in a warm place for 2 hours or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place 1 tablespoon of chilli bean paste in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with egg wash.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
